notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
We think we've achieved what we set out to do with Vendor Chronicles now, and everything seems relatively stable. Of course, if you do encounter any bugs, please let us know in the forum (or email us, that's likely to get a quicker response) and we'll get to it as soon as we can.

Thank you for supporting Vendor Chronicles, and indie games in general. We love you!

notes.title: Raids System Now Go!
notes.content:
Hello fellow gamers! We've just finished up a huge bug fix update, some gameplay tweaks, and a brand new feature: Raid Mechanics! Send your mercs out on raids, but don't leave your base too under-defended!

Please be aware that this update is not compatible with your old save files. So sorry about that!

The Future:
We're now at a point where the build is very stable (unless you guys tell us otherwise- we can't test across a wide range of systems), and has all the features we'd like to include. Unless we receive a plethora of bug reports, we're thinking about moving this out of Early Access and onto the Steam Store proper.

Changelog:
(Fixed) Random builder bug.
(Fixed) Workbench bug.
(Fixed) Negative balance bug.
(Fixed) Raider's overflow - now locked to 10 per raid.
(Fixed) OP turrets.
(Fixed) In-game prices now meet real market's prices.

(Update) Tuned bargain. It should be harder to make a profit now.
(Update) Added gun stock value indicator.
(Update) Turned off the workbench, for now.
(Update) Turned off stock upgrade due to sprite overlap.
(Update) Added map object, available after gambling table.
(Update) Added raiding feature. Mercs now can go raid Wastes, with a %chance of success

notes.title: Most recent update!
notes.content:
This should cover all known bugs! Now, onto more content!

(Fixed) Players not getting achievements unlocked
(Fixed) Players able to go minus balance when renting guns for repair purpose
(Fixed) Turret bug
(Fixed) Not able to defend self with gun under pillow
(Fixed) F12 not makes screenshots
(Fixed) Bargain Circle minigame's hitbox being shifted to the right
(Fixed) Being able to set Bargain difficulty level to value bigger then 6
(Fixed) Zombie's and raider's wave sometimes happen simultaneously
(Fixed) List auto scrolling to the top when selecting something in the bottom of the list

(Update) Increased turret and mercs price
(Update) Lowest possible price now is 10% of stock price
(Update) Added slider to the interface of lists
